Try disabling nimbusel and see if it helps? Ah I see 🙂 Yer will try nimbus & lodestar orphaned Is there a grafana dashboard for the logs? (otherwise I'll login to a client)? I'm deploying the "attacks" but they are going better than I imagined 😂 So either my ""attack"" is wrong or all clients are performing super well 😄 this should work: https://grafana.observability.ethpandaops.io/d/be08p9zqvxl34b/logs-testnets?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now&timezone=browser&var-network=fusaka-devnet-2&var-consensus=lighthouse&var-execution=geth Great thanks 😄 Sunnyside Devnet Testing with Fusaka-Devnet-2 Specification I'm preparing to make the consensus-specs alpha.3 release for devnet-3. Before doing this, I'd like to confirm that we're not missing anything. Are we? https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-3 There was a issue in spamoor. basically the goroutine that should process receipts and confirmations panicked, so no more transactions were confirmed from spamoors point of view. latest master version is fixed now, and testing on fusaka-devnet-2. Additionally, I just made this PR. How does this sound to everyone? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4415 Convert DAS providers section to superno...
